title: Lot C, empty
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Term over. Lot C empty. Wood drives there anyway on Wednesday and parks in his spot. The guard comes out. Neither says why either of them is there.

panels.composition: Lot C, empty, December, frost on the lines. The Datsun in its spot. Nothing else.

image.prompt: an empty community college parking lot in December with frost on the painted lines and one small car parked, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD in the car, BARNABY on the box. Not drawing. Just parked.

image.prompt: a young man sitting in a parked car not drawing while a small dog rests on a box in the back seat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The GUARD walking over, hands in his coat. Stopping at the hood. Not tapping.

image.prompt: a security guard standing at the hood of a parked car in an empty lot with his hands in his coat, not knocking, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The two of them, one in the car, one outside, looking at the empty lot. Nobody asks. The strip doesn't either.

image.prompt: a man standing beside a parked car and a young man inside it, both looking out at an empty frost-covered lot, black and white, no words
